svg.text: As built in the app, traced from the floor plan · same 96 × 62 m floor as before · aisle pitch 3.85 m · 112 shelf groups in 35 departments
Aisle 5, coffee bar, juices at Produce
• One colour per department. The same hex fills its shelves, tints its area
and colours its group pin and search chip.
• Every bar is one shelf = one titled group: one pin on the map, the items
• Centre gondolas along aisles 1–10 are double-sided: each side of the spine
is that face’s groups, with its own items, facing the aisle beside it.
• Aisle numbers follow the plan (there is no 12 there either). The right-hand
centre runs step shorter toward Produce, as drawn.
• The plan leaves aisles 1–17 unlabelled, so their departments here are a
sensible default — one table to change.
• Zoomed out, the map writes each department along the shelves that hold it,
beside each side of an aisle; zoomed in, each shelf carries its own title.
CENTRE AISLES AT TWICE MAP SCALE
58 groups on the two sides of the 11 centre gondolas · left and right as seen walking from the entrance
walking from the entrance toward the back wall
